## Gemini Notebook (previously NotebookLM)

Free knowledge repository.  Upload as many as 50 sources into each notebook.  Get a chatbot that answers from sources, narrated slides, podcast-style audio,  quizzes, ...

::: {.highlight-box}
- Chatbot example: [Options textbook](https://notebook.google.com/notebook/701244f5-4833-4217-875d-96380578825b)
- Narrated slides example: [Kapadia-Ostdiek-Weston paper](https://notebook.google.com/notebook/58351fb6-7453-4bff-909f-281bb34e4c6a/artifact/c78bc42e-a9e7-4276-957c-d78049841951?utm_source=nlm_web_share&utm_medium=google_oo&utm_campaign=art_share_1&utm_content=&utm_smc=nlm_web_share_google_oo_art_share_1_)
- Podcast example: [Put-call parity from textbook](https://notebook.google.com/notebook/91e987c5-e023-467f-918c-afa2264e55d4/artifact/949696bf-66a9-4ff6-beef-376aa6ca2dae?utm_source=nlm_web_share&utm_medium=google_oo&utm_campaign=art_share_1&utm_content=&utm_smc=nlm_web_share_google_oo_art_share_1_)
:::



::: {.punchline}
Chatbot is great.  Videos are good for a short change of pace.  We can specify [only use this part of the source]{.accent} for video or podcast.  Cannot revise directly but can regenerate with new instructions.
:::

## Retrieval Augmented Generation


::: {.step-flow-3}
::: {.step-card .fragment}
::: {.step-icon}
1
:::
::: {.step-title}
Prepare
:::
::: {.step-desc}
Split your documents into chunks, turn each into a numeric "embedding," and store them in a database
:::
:::
::: {.step-card .fragment}
::: {.step-icon}
2
:::
::: {.step-title}
Retrieve
:::
::: {.step-desc}
For a question, find the chunks most similar to it and hand them to the model
:::
:::
::: {.step-card .fragment}
::: {.step-icon}
3
:::
::: {.step-title}
Answer
:::
::: {.step-desc}
The model responds grounded in those chunks --- and can cite which document each came from
:::
:::
:::

::: {.punchline .centered-statement .fragment}
Gemini Notebook uses RAG
:::

## Build Your Own

::: {.two-cards}
::: {.card .card-teal .fragment}
::: {.card-title}
Chunk, embed, match
:::
- Claude can embed your sources into a database
- Finding chunks that best match a prompt is a mechanical exercise that can be scripted 
:::
::: {.card .card-amber .fragment}
::: {.card-title}
Read and interpret 
:::
- Reading the chunks and responding is AI.  Could create a custom chatbot that makes API calls (more later).
- Or could use Claude as the AI.  Create a Claude skill and include the database
:::
:::

::: {.info-box .fragment}
[Why Build Your Own]{.box-title}

- More than 50 sources (research database --- more later)
- More control over answers (via system prompt --- more later)
:::

- Start a new conversation
- Enter [/binomial-tutor]{.accent}
